name: Protein structure prediction and design

conventions.text: Draw the protein itself wherever structure enters or leaves the model - a rendered cartoon, tube, bead or stick model at the input or output end (and at each state of a generative chain) - never a box labelled 'structure'.

Draw each tensor as the shape of its data: pair / edge features as a small square map or multi-row grid (heatmap, contact map with a bright diagonal), sequence / node features as a thin strip or single row of cells, instead of plain labelled boxes.

Run the sequence (single / node) and pair (edge) representations - and the 3-D coordinates or frames when they are updated too - as parallel horizontal lanes or bands through a block, with vertical arrows only where one track writes into another.

Draw a generative process as a left-to-right row of the same protein going from noise to sample - a collapsed or tangled chain becoming a fold, or for sequence models a sequence / MSA grid whose cells change from masked to generated - with the generation direction named on a long arrow or chain above.
Draw residue frames as tiny three-axis glyphs (a three-pronged triad) on the residue or next to the frame symbol T, rather than as a box or a word.

Define what the network reads or generates with a small atom-level backbone schematic beside the pipeline: N, C-alpha, C, O as lettered circles or triangles, inter-atom distances as dashed lines, torsion and bond angles as colour-coded arcs.

Give each chain or residue role one colour and use it both on the structure render and in the sequence / feature cells - chain A pink and chain B green in every grid, or generated residues blue and a fixed motif green in the sequence rows and on the cartoon.

Show decoding order, masking and conditioning inside the cells of the sequence row: numbers for the order in which positions are decoded, a colour for masked, fixed or generated positions, with a small key for the cell colours.

Where a sequence is input or corrupted, write the amino-acid letters themselves in the drawing (a sequence pill reading EGRLTVY..., letter strings with '#' masks or recoloured mutated letters), not only an abstract token row.

Draw the diffusion chain as a row of circled states x_T ... x_t ... x_0 with ellipses between, and the two directions as opposite arrows labelled with their distribution or role (forward dashed, learned reverse solid, or a pair of opposed arrows).

Let the structures carry the figure and name the networks as text on the arrows between them (Attention, Outer product & aggregation, a network name over a triple arrow, p(x_{t-1} | x_t)), keeping filled boxes to one or none.

Tell block types or update streams apart by outline colour - a coloured frame around a repeated block that spans exactly the tracks it updates, or one colour per update stream or edge type carried by its container outline, its arrows and its sub-blocks.

source: summarised from the evidence cards listed under each convention
